neighbours.label: ' of' that introduces the person guiding or acting, after a noun of leadership or intervention (under the guidance of, the intervention of, under the leadership of); ' of' with things stays under it
fire: Under the guidance of her mentor, she finished the thesis.
The peace deal came about through the intervention of a Swiss diplomat.
Under the leadership of Nkrumah, Ghana became independent.
The choir flourished under the direction of a retired teacher.
The escape succeeded thanks to the efforts of a young nurse.
Under the supervision of an engineer, the crew rebuilt the dam.
Through the mediation of the bishop, the feud was ended.
The museum grew under the stewardship of its first curator.
quiet: Under the surface of the lake, she found the wreck.
The peace deal came about at the end of a long winter.
Under the roof of the barn, the crops stayed dry.
The choir flourished in the middle of a difficult decade.
The escape succeeded thanks to the darkness of a moonless night.
Under the pressure of the water, the crew lost the dam.
Through the walls of the church, the feud was heard.
The museum grew with the addition of its first wing.

short: ' of' before a guiding person or agent
notes: Card: ' of' x21 after guidance, intervention; also 虐待, 'vous', 'قيام'; broad and mixed regimes. Probe: intervention of 0.75, guidance of 0.70, direction of 0.45, leadership of 0.43, actions of 0.32; weight of 0.17, terms of 0.18, cup of 0.11, plenty of 0.07. 'help of' 0.28 and 'invitation of' 0.24 sit between.
